items.title: CRF Announces Late-Breaking Clinical Trials and Science to Be Presented at TCT 2026
items.title_zh: CRF公布TCT 2026(10月31日-11月3日,圣地亚哥)重磅揭晓研究名单:28项研究含二尖瓣ENCIRCLE 2年结果、三尖瓣TRIC-I-HF-DZHK24亚组分析、左心耳封堵Amulet 360一年结果及LANTERN个体数据荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 心血管研究基金会(CRF)公布将于2026年10月31日至11月3日在圣地亚哥举行的TCT 2026年会重磅揭晓(late-breaking)研究与科学报告名单,涵盖冠脉、结构性心脏病、外周血管、肾脏去神经及抗栓等6个专场共28项研究。结构性心脏病相关看点包括:经导管二尖瓣置换ENCIRCLE研究2年随访结果(John G. Webb教授报告)、心衰患者三尖瓣介入TRIC-I-HF-DZHK24试验关键亚组分析、新一代Amulet 360左心耳封堵器VERITAS研究1年结果,以及LANTERN左心耳封堵与药物治疗预防房颤卒中的个体患者数据荟萃分析。多场专场将与《柳叶刀》《Circulation》《NEJM》《欧洲心脏杂志》《JACC》及《JAMA》联合发布。
items.summary_en: The Cardiovascular Research Foundation (CRF) announced the late-breaking clinical trials and science slate for TCT 2026 (October 31-November 3, San Diego), spanning 28 studies across six sessions in coronary, structural heart, peripheral vascular, renal denervation, and antithrombotic therapy. Structural heart highlights include 2-year outcomes from the ENCIRCLE transcatheter mitral valve replacement trial (presented by John G. Webb), key subgroup results from the TRIC-I-HF-DZHK24 tricuspid intervention-in-heart-failure trial, 1-year data on the next-generation Amulet 360 left atrial appendage occluder (VERITAS Amulet 360 study), and the LANTERN individual-patient-data meta-analysis comparing LAA closure with medical therapy for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation. Several sessions will be co-published with The Lancet, Circulation, NEJM, the European Heart Journal, JACC, and JAMA.

items.title: Five-Year Outcomes of Transcatheter Mitral Valve Replacement in Patients With Severe Symptomatic Mitral Regurgitation: Results From the Tendyne Expanded Clinical Study
items.title_zh: Tendyne扩展临床研究5年随访(ESC Heart Failure):191例重度症状性二尖瓣反流患者经心尖TMVR,5年时95.3%患者反流≤1+,存活者73.5%达NYHA I/II级,未见结构性瓣膜退化
items.summary_zh: 该前瞻性、单臂、多中心研究(2014年11月至2020年6月入组)纳入191例重度症状性二尖瓣反流(88.5%为继发性MR)患者,其中186例(97.4%)成功接受经心尖Tendyne经导管二尖瓣置换。5年随访显示,反流程度由基线99.5%患者≥3+降至95.3%患者≤1+;存活至5年的患者中73.5%心功能达NYHA I/II级,且未观察到结构性瓣膜退化。研究提示Tendyne系统在高危二尖瓣反流患者中可实现即刻且持久的反流消除,长期耐久性良好。
items.summary_en: This prospective, single-arm, multicentre Tendyne Expanded Clinical Study (enrolled November 2014-June 2020) followed 191 patients with severe symptomatic mitral regurgitation (88.5% secondary MR), of whom 186 (97.4%) underwent transapical Tendyne transcatheter mitral valve replacement. At 5 years, MR grade fell from ≥3+ in 99.5% of patients at baseline to ≤1+ in 95.3%; among 5-year survivors, 73.5% were in NYHA class I/II, with no structural valve deterioration observed. The results support durable, sustained elimination of MR with Tendyne TMVR in a high-surgical-risk population.

items.title: Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Replacement Reduces Heart Failure Hospitalization: Insights From the Canadian Evoque Registry
items.title_zh: 加拿大Evoque注册研究(Canadian Journal of Cardiology):75例高危重度三尖瓣反流患者行Evoque TTVR后,心衰住院年化发生率较术前相对下降76.1%,1年死亡率6.7%
items.summary_zh: 该前瞻性多中心加拿大注册研究纳入75例接受Edwards EVOQUE经导管三尖瓣置换的高危重度三尖瓣反流患者(STS评分8.2%±5.9%)。技术成功率97.3%、器械成功率93.3%,94.3%患者术后反流降至轻度及以下;与术前12个月相比,术后12个月心衰住院年化发生率相对下降76.1%,1年全因死亡率为6.7%。研究以加拿大真实世界数据证实TTVR不仅能消除三尖瓣反流,还能显著降低心衰再住院负担。
items.summary_en: This prospective, multicentre Canadian registry enrolled 75 high-surgical-risk patients (STS score 8.2%±5.9%) with severe tricuspid regurgitation who underwent transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement with the Edwards EVOQUE system. Technical and device success rates were 97.3% and 93.3%, respectively, with TR reduced to ≤mild in 94.3% of patients; comparing the 12 months after versus before the procedure, the annualized heart failure hospitalization rate fell by a relative 76.1%, and 1-year all-cause mortality was 6.7%. The findings provide real-world Canadian evidence that TTVR not only eliminates TR but also meaningfully reduces the burden of heart failure rehospitalization.

items.title: Closing the Gap: Why Percutaneous Patent Foramen Ovale and All Atrial Septal Defect Closures Belong in the NCDR IMPACT Registry
items.title_zh: JSCAI观点文章:呼吁将全部经皮卵圆孔未闭(PFO)与房间隔缺损(ASD)封堵纳入美国NCDR IMPACT注册库,以支撑质量改进、上市后监测与真实世界证据
items.summary_zh: 发表于《美国心血管造影与介入学会杂志》(JSCAI)的这篇观点文章指出,尽管经皮卵圆孔未闭(PFO)与房间隔缺损(ASD)封堵已广泛开展多年,但美国NCDR IMPACT注册库目前并未强制纳入全部此类操作,导致缺乏统一的基准比较、质量改进及上市后监测数据。作者呼吁推动将全部PFO/ASD经皮封堵纳入该注册库,认为这将有助于生成真实世界证据、指导临床指南与支付方政策制定,同时也点出偏头痛/短暂性脑缺血适应证及术后房颤风险等仍存争议的问题,是当前结构性心脏病介入领域讨论的热点之一。
items.summary_en: This perspective piece in the Journal of the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions (JSCAI) argues that despite years of widespread use, percutaneous patent foramen ovale (PFO) and atrial septal defect (ASD) closures are not uniformly captured in the U.S. NCDR IMPACT registry, leaving gaps in benchmarking, quality improvement, and postmarket surveillance. The authors call for mandatory registry inclusion of all PFO/ASD closures to generate real-world evidence that could inform clinical guidelines and payer policy, while flagging unresolved debates — such as closure for migraine/TIA indications and post-procedure atrial fibrillation risk — that continue to divide the structural heart community.

items.title: More than Fluid: AI-Derived Pleural Effusion Volume as a Marker of Cardiovascular Congestion in Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation
items.title_zh: AI量化术前胸腔积液体积与TAVI预后(Medical Sciences):积液量反映心血管淤血程度,但充分校正后与远期死亡率无独立相关(HR 1.00,95% CI 0.93-1.08,P=0.976)
items.summary_zh: 该回顾性研究纳入2016-2022年间接受经股动脉TAVI且术前有CT影像的连续患者,采用AI分割工作流自动量化术前胸腔积液体积,分析其与心血管淤血标志物及远期死亡率的关系。结果显示,AI量化的胸腔积液体积与血流动力学淤血及不良心脏重构指标相关,但充分校正混杂因素后,对数转换的积液体积并非远期死亡率的独立预测因子(HR 1.00,95% CI 0.93-1.08,P=0.976)。提示胸腔积液负荷的价值更多在于反映心血管疾病严重程度分型,而非用于风险分层。
items.summary_en: This retrospective study included consecutive patients undergoing transfemoral TAVI (2016-2022) with available pre-procedural CT, using an AI-based segmentation workflow to automatically quantify pleural effusion volume and relate it to markers of cardiovascular congestion and long-term mortality. AI-derived pleural effusion volume correlated with hemodynamic congestion and adverse cardiac remodeling, but after full adjustment, log-transformed pleural effusion volume was not independently associated with mortality (HR 1.00, 95% CI 0.93-1.08; P=0.976) — suggesting its value lies in phenotyping disease severity rather than risk stratification.
